request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Mirecrown Newt".

Creative brief
Name: Mirecrown Newt
Collection: Mirebound Court. Swamp creatures serving a drowned marsh court, marked by reeds, lilies, mud, spores, leeches, and deceptive water formations.
Core concept: A slow royal caster that surrounds itself with rotating globules.
Body and silhouette: Upright newt with a broad head, short limbs, long tail, and a crown of marsh reeds.
Signature features: Reed crown, pearl-like throat spots, and a mud-stained mantle.
Palette and materials: Deep teal, muted gold, peat brown, and pale aqua.
Movement personality: Proud, measured, and ceremonially slow.
Attack concept: Summons four water globes that orbit once before launching outward one at a time toward the player.
Directional details: The crown’s tallest reed leans toward the left.
Avoid: Full humanoid king, jeweled luxury crown, realistic amphibian proportions.
